description: Source code for content flagging API endpoints and related logic in Mattermost, including route initialization, permission checks, post flagging, configuration management, and reviewer assignment.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Main API struct for handling content flagging routes and logic.

methods.name: InitContentFlagging
methods.description: Initializes content flagging related API routes if feature flag is enabled.

methods.name: requireContentFlaggingAvailable
methods.description: Checks if content flagging feature is available under license.

methods.name: requireContentFlaggingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if content flagging is enabled in configuration.

methods.name: contentFlaggingRequired
methods.description: Middleware to ensure content flagging is enabled before proceeding.

methods.name: requireTeamContentReviewer
methods.description: Verifies if a user is a reviewer for a specific team.

methods.name: requireFlaggedPost
methods.description: Ensures a post is flagged before proceeding.

methods.name: getFlaggingConfiguration
methods.description: Returns content flagging configuration, with extra info if user is a reviewer.

methods.name: getTeamPostFlaggingFeatureStatus
methods.description: Returns whether content flagging is enabled for a team.

methods.name: flagPost
methods.description: Handles flagging a post, with permission and validity checks.

methods.name: getFlaggingConfig
methods.description: Builds configuration report for flagging, tailored for reviewers if needed.

methods.name: getContentFlaggingFields
methods.description: Retrieves mapped content flagging fields.

methods.name: getPostPropertyValues
methods.description: Fetches content flagging property values for a post, requires reviewer permission.

methods.name: getFlaggedPost
methods.description: Retrieves a flagged post if user has permission and post is flagged.

methods.name: removeFlaggedPost
methods.description: Permanently deletes a flagged post, with audit logging.

methods.name: keepFlaggedPost
methods.description: Marks a flagged post to be kept, with audit logging.

methods.name: keepRemoveFlaggedPostChecks
methods.description: Performs common checks for keep/remove actions on flagged posts.

methods.name: saveContentFlaggingSettings
methods.description: Saves content flagging configuration, requires system permission.

methods.name: getContentFlaggingSettings
methods.description: Retrieves current content flagging settings and reviewer IDs.

methods.name: searchReviewers
methods.description: Searches for reviewers within a team based on a search term.

methods.name: assignFlaggedPostReviewer
methods.description: Assigns a reviewer to a flagged post, with permission checks.

methods.name: checkPostTypeFlaggable
methods.description: Validates if a post type is eligible for flagging.
